I now have enough data to produce a complete, well-grounded analysis. Let me compile the findings.

---

## Reference Implementation Summary — `sjarmak/codeprobe` @ `6052fec`

**Language/framework:** Python 3.11+, stdlib (`subprocess`, `threading`, `ThreadPoolExecutor`, `contextlib`, `dataclasses`, `pathlib`), `uv`/`pyproject.toml` packaging, CLI via Click, no async.

**Engineering intent:** A self-contained coding-agent evaluation harness that:
1. **Mines** real coding tasks from merged PR history via `git` and the GitHub/GitLab APIs.
2. **Executes** agent configs (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) against those tasks inside isolated git worktrees, with thread-parallel dispatch, checkpointing, and per-run sandbox scoring.
3. **Scores** results using binary/continuous/dual/IR scorers, each run in a per-trial temp-dir snapshot so concurrent runs never share mutable state.
4. **Reports** cost, token, latency, and pass-rate metrics across named experiment configs.

**Key structural signals for comparison:**
- `WorktreeIsolation` — pool of `git worktree add --detach` slots, acquire/release/cleanup protocol
- `execute_task` / `execute_config` — never-raise task runner, error categories (`quota/timeout/system/agent`), `ThreadPoolExecutor` parallel dispatch
- `quarantine_local_source` — context-manager file stash (hide/scaffold modes)
- `CheckpointStore` — JSONL append-then-resume
- `ExperimentConfig` + `CompletedTask` — frozen dataclasses serialized to JSON
- `get_scorer(reward_type)` dispatch to `BinaryScorer`, `ContinuousScorer`, `DualScorer`, `IRScorer`
- `pyproject.toml` packaging, `uv.lock`, Apache-2.0

**Change-size heuristic:** The reference is a large, purpose-built project (~30 source files in `core/` + `mining/` + `adapters/` + `analysis/`). Comparable implementations must also be substantial agent evaluation harnesses, not single-script wrappers.

**Exclusion criteria applied to every candidate below:**
- Vendored: file must not be a dependency mirror or a generated lockfile.
- Generated/fixture: file must be primary production code, not test data.
- Tutorial/copy: README-driven hello-world or copied SWE-bench sample scripts excluded.
- Language match required: Python.
- Framework context: agent-evaluation harness or a structurally isomorphic sub-system.

---

## Candidates in the Active Study Context

### Candidate 1 — `github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest` — `evaluation/` subsystem

**Eligibility checks:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Language | Python — pass |
| Vendored/generated | No — primary production code in `evaluation/utils/shared.py`, `evaluation/benchmarks/swe_bench/run_infer.py`; not a mirror of a library | 
| Tutorial/fixture | No — operational evaluation harness |
| Engineering intent | Run LLM-backed coding agents against software-engineering tasks and score the outcomes — identical top-level purpose |
| Framework/API context | `subprocess`, `multiprocessing`, Docker runtime isolation, JSONL checkpoint resumption, retry logic with categorized error types |
| Change size | Comparable — `evaluation/` contains `shared.py` (600+ lines), `run_infer.py` (500+ lines), plus 15+ additional `run_infer.py` instances per benchmark; substantial multi-file system |

**Functional mapping:**

| codeprobe concept | OpenHands equivalent |
|---|---|
| [`execute_config`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/src/codeprobe/core/executor.py?L1043) — iterates tasks, dispatches parallel workers | [`run_evaluation`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/utils/shared.py?L493-552) — iterates dataset rows, dispatches to `mp.Pool.imap_unordered` or sequential loop |
| [`execute_task`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/src/codeprobe/core/executor.py?L461) — never-raise single task runner, error classification | [`_process_instance_wrapper`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/utils/shared.py?L394-486) — per-instance wrapper with retry loop and error classification (`EvalException`, `EvalTimeoutException`, runtime errors) |
| [`CompletedTask`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/src/codeprobe/core/experiment.py?L356) + JSONL checkpoint append | [`EvalOutput`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/utils/shared.py?L59) Pydantic model + JSONL append in `update_progress` |
| `prepare_dataset` / checkpointed_ids filter (skip already-run tasks) | [`prepare_dataset`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/utils/shared.py?L219) — reads `output_file` for `finished_ids` and excludes them |
| `WorktreeIsolation` (git worktree pool) | Docker container per instance — `get_config` selects a per-instance Docker image; isolation is container-level rather than worktree-level |
| `EvalMetadata` / `ExperimentConfig` + JSON save | [`EvalMetadata`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/utils/shared.py?L44) Pydantic model written to `metadata.json` |
| `make_metadata` / `create_experiment_dir` | [`make_metadata`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/utils/shared.py?L164) — constructs output directory and writes `metadata.json` |
| `_score_in_sandbox` / `get_scorer` | [`process_instance` in `eval_infer.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/benchmarks/swe_bench/eval_infer.py?L103) — invokes `swebench` grading harness to score agent patch against test suite |
| `preamble_names` / `instruction_variant` | Jinja2 `template_name` selection in [`get_instruction`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/benchmarks/swe_bench/run_infer.py?L109) |
| `_classify_error` → `error_category` | [`is_fatal_runtime_error` / `runtime_failure_count`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/utils/shared.py?L480) — separate runtime-disconnect tracking |
| `reset_logger_for_multiprocessing` | [`reset_logger_for_multiprocessing`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/utils/shared.py?L559) — identical purpose and name |
| `budget_checker` / `max_cost_usd` | No direct equivalent; OpenHands does not implement a cost-budget halt |
| `quarantine_local_source` | No direct equivalent; OpenHands uses immutable per-instance Docker images instead of workspace stashing |
| `mining/` (PR extraction) | No direct equivalent; SWE-bench dataset is pre-built and loaded from HuggingFace |

**Differentiating factors (non-disqualifying):**
- codeprobe uses `ThreadPoolExecutor` (threads, IO-bound); OpenHands uses `multiprocessing.Pool` (processes, needed for full runtime isolation within the same host).
- codeprobe's isolation is git-worktree-based (filesystem copy + git plumbing); OpenHands's isolation is Docker-container-based (one container per instance).
- codeprobe implements its own task mining pipeline; OpenHands consumes pre-existing benchmark datasets.
- codeprobe's scorer dispatch is internal; OpenHands delegates final scoring to the external `swebench` grading harness.
- OpenHands does not implement budget enforcement or source-quarantine modes.

**Verdict:** Functionally comparable at the evaluation-harness level. The `run_evaluation` + `_process_instance_wrapper` + `EvalOutput`/`EvalMetadata` + JSONL checkpoint + parallel dispatch subsystem in [`evaluation/utils/shared.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/utils/shared.py) directly parallels codeprobe's [`execute_config`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/src/codeprobe/core/executor.py?L1043) + [`execute_task`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/src/codeprobe/core/executor.py?L461) + [`CompletedTask`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/sjarmak-codeprobe@6052fec96850a06b18527a9bb8e41243bc1cbdb1/-/blob/src/codeprobe/core/experiment.py) core. The engineering intent — run a configurable agent against a task set, record structured outputs, resume from checkpoint, categorize errors, and report metrics — is the same. The isolation mechanism (Docker vs. git worktree) and dataset source (pre-built vs. mined) differ in implementation but serve the same architectural role.

---

### All other repositories in the active context — ineligible

The remaining repositories in the study context fall into the following disqualifying categories:

| Repository group | Disqualification reason |
|---|---|
| `sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic` | Python backup orchestration tool — no agent evaluation, no task mining, no scorer dispatch. Different domain entirely. |
| `sg-evals/poezio-poezio` | Python XMPP client — different domain. |
| `sg-evals/qemu-project-qemu` | C/C++ machine emulator — wrong language. |
| `sg-evals/superseriousbusiness-gotosocial` | Go ActivityPub server — wrong language, different domain. |
| `sg-evals/wafrn-wafrn` | TypeScript social network — wrong language. |
| All `sg-evals/*--<version>` pinned mirrors (flask, click, pandas, django, kafka, etcd, grpc, tokio, rust-csv, etc.) | Pinned upstream library snapshots — these are study mirrors of OSS libraries for benchmark tasks, not evaluation harnesses. Structurally they are the *subjects* of an evaluation, not the harness. |
| `spring-projects/*` family | Java Spring ecosystem — wrong language. |
| `apache/commons-*` | Java — wrong language. |
| `sourcegraph/*` (zoekt, src-cli, scip-*) | Go/TypeScript search/indexing infrastructure — different domain, different language. |
| `gitlab.com/gitlab-org/*` | Ruby/Go — wrong language for the core harness. |
| `sourcegraph-community/*` (podcast-*, mcpregistry, etc.) | Demo repos, skills wrappers, or empty stubs — change size too small, different domain. |
| `github.com/trly/*` | Personal utility repos (quad-ops, MagicMirror, today) — different domain. |
| `github.com/pbakaus/impeccable` | Design language documentation — different domain. |
| `react/react`, `remix-run/react-router`, etc. | JavaScript UI frameworks — wrong language. |
| `llvm/llvm-project`, `ghostty-org/ghostty` | C++/Swift system tools — wrong language. |
| `gradle/gradle` | Groovy/Java build tool — wrong language. |

---

## Summary

Only one repository in the active study context contains a functionally comparable implementation:

**[`github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest)** — specifically the [`evaluation/utils/shared.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/utils/shared.py) core harness and the [`evaluation/benchmarks/swe_bench/run_infer.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/benchmarks/swe_bench/run_infer.py) + [`eval_infer.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/OpenHands--latest/-/blob/evaluation/benchmarks/swe_bench/eval_infer.py) benchmark adapters.

The match is at the level of the **evaluation-harness pattern**: task iteration, parallel worker dispatch, structured per-result output model, JSONL checkpoint/resume, error classification with retry, and per-benchmark `process_instance` adapters — the same architectural decisions made in codeprobe's `execute_config`/`execute_task`/`CompletedTask`/`CheckpointStore` stack. The isolation mechanism (Docker vs. git worktree), dataset acquisition strategy (HuggingFace dataset vs. mined PR history), and cost-enforcement feature set differ in implementation while serving the same overall system role.
